name: WorkArena
summary: ServiceNow browser-task benchmark for knowledge-work agents, evaluated through BrowserGym, with an Apache-2.0 Python package.
description: Established 2024 benchmark (ServiceNow/WorkArena; ICML 2024 paper, WorkArena++ NeurIPS 2024). GitHub license API reports NOASSERTION, but the repository LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2024 ServiceNow) — that file is the basis for this entry's license field. Not archived. Install browsergym-workarena (PyPI 0.5.3 verified 2026-11-10) plus Playwright. Setup also requires access to ServiceNow instances (credentials/instances are not included). Preferred evaluation path documented via AgentLab and the BrowserGym leaderboard. Not a newly launched 2026 product. Instance access and model costs are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public code and docs. Running the benchmark requires a ServiceNow instance plus the browsergym-workarena package.
